# Gateway grouped video fixtures

These files are byte-for-byte copies of synthetic HTTP responses generated by the gateway. Both include the account pricing response and the single-model contract response.

| File | Model | Effective video version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [catalog.json](catalog.json) | `example-group-video` | `e086f5bb6394f409` |
| [mixed-catalog.json](mixed-catalog.json) | `example-mixed-video` | `58cff3fa201d19bf` |

Source commit `bd4aef44082fdf0c6f0cc9dc0d485f616e468798`. [Gateway producer PR](https://github.com/omnimux-ai/omnimux-gateway/pull/76) · [Producer fixture directory](https://github.com/omnimux-ai/omnimux-gateway/tree/bd4aef44082fdf0c6f0cc9dc0d485f616e468798/router/testdata/issue-74)

The gateway checks both files with `go test ./router -run '^TestRegisteredVideoProtocolCatalogAndRoutes$' -count=1`. The client checks the pinned bytes, catalog projection, validation, submit and recovery with `corepack pnpm --dir plugins run verify:model-contracts`. When taking a new gateway version, copy the producer files and update the source commit, versions and digests in the accompanying client test.
